versions.content: Service Name Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> Syntax BufReq_ReturnType Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyCopyRxData_<CGI> ( const PduInfoType * info, PduLengthType * bufferSizePtr ) Service ID [hex] 0xTBD Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant Parameters (in) info Provides the source buffer (SduDataPtr) and the number of bytes to be copied (SduLength). An SduLength of 0 can be used to query the current amount of available buffer in the upper layer module. In this case, the SduDataPtr may be a NULL_PTR. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) bufferSizePtr Available receive buffer after data has been copied. Return value BufReq_ReturnType BUFREQ_OK: Data copied successfully. BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK: Data was not copied because an error occurred. Description Rte_Rips_NotifyCopyRxData provides the RTE Implementation Plug-In with the received data of an I-PDU segment from the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph requiring transformation. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom_TP Rte_ LdComCbkCopyRxData callback. See requirement [SWS_LDCOM_00030] for more details on the functionality of this callback. Available via Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
